environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task but with a custom OCI runtime seccomp profile loaded via ECS task definition 'linuxParameters.systemControls' and a gVisor-based runtime sandbox (runsc). The seccomp profile (applied at container level via 'dockerSecurityOpt') uses a whitelist approach: it permits read, write, openat, close, fstat, mmap, mprotect, brk, ioctl, access, pipe, select, clone, execve, wait4, getpid, socket(AF_INET only), connect, sendto, recvfrom, bind, listen, accept, fcntl, futex, epoll_create, epoll_ctl, epoll_wait, and sigaction. Critically, the profile DENIES the 'execve' syscall for any process whose argv[0] does not match the patterns '/usr/bin/python3*' or '/usr/local/bin/gunicorn'. Additionally, the task definition sets 'readonlyRootFilesystem: true' with only /tmp and /var/lib/reports mounted as writable tmpfs volumes (noexec flag set). The ALB has a request body size limit of 1KB enforced via listener rule condition.

config.seccomp_profile: custom-whitelist-v3.json: execve restricted to argv[0] matching /usr/bin/python3* or /usr/local/bin/gunicorn only
